AIM-120D.name: AIM-120D AMRAAM
AIM-120D.desc: Two-way datalink and GPS-guided navigation enhancement to standard AMRAAM envelope.

AGM-88C.name: AGM-88C HARM
AGM-88C.desc: Suppression of Enemy Air Defenses (SEAD) weapon designed to home in on enemy radar emissions.

GBU-39.name: GBU-39 SDB
GBU-39.desc: Small Diameter Bomb allowing 4x multi-target strikes per BRU-61 rack with high standoff.

GBU-27.name: GBU-27 Paveway III
GBU-27.desc: 2,000 lb BLU-109 laser-guided penetrator engineered to crack subterranean C2 fortresses.

AIM-260.name: AIM-260 JATM
AIM-260.desc: Joint Advanced Tactical Missile. Long-range ramjet Fox-3 with high no-escape envelope.

AIM-174B.name: AIM-174B Gunslinger
AIM-174B.desc: Ultra long-range hypersonic fleet defense interceptor missile. Dominates extreme standoff BVR.

R-77-1.name: R-77-1 (AA-12 Adder)
R-77-1.desc: Streamlined radome and active radar homing head for reliable mid-range engagements.

Kh-31P.name: Kh-31P (AS-17 Krypton)
Kh-31P.desc: High-velocity ramjet anti-radar missile designed to overwhelm Patriot and Hawk battery response times.

PL-15.name: PL-15 Dual-Pulse
PL-15.desc: Dual-pulse solid rocket motor missile with extended no-escape zone.

R-37M.name: R-37M Axehead
R-37M.desc: Very long-range Mach 6 sniper missile designed for AWACS, tanker, and high-altitude intercept.

Kh-47M2.name: Kh-47M2 Kinzhal
Kh-47M2.desc: Hypersonic aero-ballistic missile with devastating kinetic impact on hardened structures.
